message.content:
Fix one review finding on PR #402 (SMA-863) in the worktree /Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon/.worktrees/sma-863 (branch feature/sma-863-anthropic-and-bedrock-emit-no-toolcalldelta).

## The finding (verified by the controller)
The core `Model::invoke` contract (crates/paigasus-helikon-core/src/model.rs ~L66-72) says an implementation MUST NOT emit `Finish` on cancellation. In the anthropic and bedrock drivers, the `tokio::select!` checks the `CancellationToken` only while waiting for the next upstream event. Once an upstream event (or the clean-EOF `translator.finish()`) produces several `ModelEvent`s, the driver yields them in a `for` loop with no cancel check. A consumer that receives the first one, cancels, and polls again can still receive a later `Finish`. This branch widened that window: `finish()` now returns a `Vec` (a safety-net `ToolCallDelta` plus `Finish`), and the anthropic `MessageStop` arm can now return a `ToolCallDelta` before `Finish`.

## Required change
In both `crates/paigasus-helikon-providers-anthropic/src/model.rs` (~L106-160) and `crates/paigasus-helikon-providers-bedrock/src/model.rs` (~L141-175): before EACH `yield` inside the clean-EOF drain loop (`for .. in translator.finish()`) and inside the `consume` result loop, check `cancel.is_cancelled()` and `return` (no further yields) if it fired. Keep it minimal: one short guard per loop, with a one-line comment citing the contract ("no event after cancellation, so no Finish after cancel"). Do not touch gemini or other providers. Do not change any other behaviour.

## Test
Add one test per crate that pins the behaviour, if it can be done without network access:
- bedrock `model.rs` already has cancellation tests (`cancel_before_stream_ends_no_finish`, `cancel_mid_stream_no_finish`, `uncancelled_stream_emits_finish` near L358-410). Read how they build the stream and add `cancel_between_buffered_events_yields_no_finish`: drive a stream whose one upstream step yields two or more events ending in `Finish` (for example a tool start with no delta and no stop, then `MessageStop(ToolUse)` and `Metadata`, so the Metadata step yields `Usage`, net `ToolCallDelta`, `Finish`), take the first yielded event, cancel the token, then assert the stream ends with no `Finish`.
- anthropic: look for an existing driver-level test harness (a local HTTP server or mock SSE body, e.g. in `tests/` or `model.rs` tests). If one exists, add the analogous test. If no harness exists without real network, do not build a new one; say so in the report.
Record RED (the test fails before the guard) and GREEN.

## Working rules
Start every shell command with `cd /Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon/.worktrees/sma-863 || exit 1`. Absolute paths with that root for Read/Edit/Write. NEVER git checkout, switch, reset, stash, rebase, push, or `git add -A`; add files by path. Work synchronously in the foreground; never background cargo; do not end until each command finishes.
Before committing run: `cargo test -p paigasus-helikon-providers-anthropic -p paigasus-helikon-providers-bedrock`, `cargo test -p paigasus-helikon-provider-stream-conformance`, `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings`.
Commit: `fix(providers): SMA-863 stop yielding buffered events after cancellation` with trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. Do not push.
You do not dispatch subagents.

## Report
Write the report (change with file:line, RED/GREEN evidence, test counts, gate outputs) to /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-smaschek-dev-paigasus-paigasus-helikon/173218de-ef1d-4f01-8e75-351491cd9f9d/scratchpad/cr-r1-fix-report.md, then reply with ONLY (under 12 lines): Status, commit, test summary, whether each crate got a test, concerns.

<system-reminder>
Your final report is delivered through SubagentHandback: when your work is complete, call SubagentHandback({message: <your full report>}). The call ends your run, so make it your last step. Only a SubagentHandback call reaches your caller as your result; plain text you write at the end is not delivered. Do not also send the report with SendMessage: your caller would get it twice.
</system-reminder>
